summary: The proposed patch reverts the hash calculation for Django model fields to be based solely on the creation counter, which should resolve the immutability issue without introducing significant risks.

issues.description: There is a risk that reverting the hash calculation might affect other parts of the codebase that rely on the previous hash implementation, potentially leading to unexpected behavior.
The code style could be improved by adding a comment explaining why the hash is now based solely on the creation counter.
